classification_rationale: Demonstrated engineering (local inference stacks): local LLM inference runtimes with documented low-bit quantisation exist (llama.cpp), post-training quantisation to 3-4 bits at LLM scale shows small measured degradation on its published benchmarks (GPTQ), and measured bit-level trade-offs find 4-bit near-optimal for zero-shot accuracy at fixed total model bits on the studied model families (k-bit inference scaling laws); model-capability or quantisation claims beyond these named results are external facts requiring verification (G face).
implementation_seam: Backend-matrix smoke test with a recorded task-level accuracy check
legitimate_uses: Local, air-gapped analysis tooling under the repository's existing gates
minimal_evidence_before_implementation: A task-level accuracy check before relying on quantised outputs in any evidence lane
neutral_name: Local inference and low-bit quantisation for on-premise models
